title: Freebie Bundle on Last-Time-Buy Stocks

body:
Up to 5% discount on participating HP Smart Buy business notebooks.
Tier is computed per SKU, per invoice: 2–15 units 1% · 16–25 units 1.5% · 26–50 units 3% · 51–99 units 4% · 100+ units 5%.
Discount is applied by the distributor at the time of the transaction.
Eligible: participating HP Smart Buy business notebooks (listed below).
Quantities from multiple SKUs or multiple invoices cannot be combined to reach a higher tier.
Participating distributors: VST ECS Inc., Iontech Inc. and Wordtext Systems Inc.
72R and A9R rebate deals are excluded. HP Inc. reserves the right to reject claims outside the mechanics.
title: Q426 HP Smart Buy Program: Higher Tier, Higher Discount

body:
Every qualifying unit comes with a free HP Series 3 Pro 23.8" FHD Monitor / 324pv (SKU 9U5C1AA) and a free HP 235 Slim Wireless Mouse (SKU 4E407UT).

Eligible models (6): ZBook 8 G1i CJ9R8PT, ZBook Ultra G1a CJ9S2PT and CJ9S3PT, Z2 Mini G1a CJ9S4PT, Z2 Tower G1i CJ9S6PT and CW6L5PT.
Exclusive to participating HP dealers and resellers. Valid until November 15, 2026, while promotional supplies last. Free monitor and mouse are subject to availability; promotional items and incentives are subject to campaign validation, and Iontech may verify qualifying purchases before releasing incentives. Prices shown on the flyer are Iontech distributor prices.
Contact your Iontech sales representative for availability and ordering.
